senses.gloss:
नैश नैश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निशा), nocturnal,
nightly, relating to the night; a person &c. doing
anything by night; done at night; to be observed
by night.

नैशाकर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निशा-कर), caused by
or belonging to the moon, &c.

नैशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, nocturnal, happening at night,
obtained in one night, &c.

नैश्चल्य नैश्चल्य, अम्, n. fixedness, fixity,
immovableness.

नैश्चित्य नैश्चित्य, अम्, n. (fr. निश्-चित), de-
termination, certainty; a fixed ceremony or festival
(as a birth, investiture, marriage, &c.).

नैश्चिन्त्य नैश्चिन्त्य, अम्, n. (fr. निश्-चिन्त),
freedom from anxiety, absence of care.

नैषदिक नैषदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-षद्),
sitting, (not lying down.)

नैषध नैषध, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to
Niṣadha; (अस्), m. a prince of the Niṣadhas,
especially an epithet of Nala; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the
people of Niṣadha; a species of plant used as food;
(अम्), n. or नैषध-चरित, अम्, n., N. of an
artificial epic poem by Śrī-harṣa, treating of Nala's
adventures.
—नैषधचरित-भाव-द्योतनिका,
f. ‘an explanation of the meaning of the Naiṣadha-
carita,’ N. of a commentary on the preceding poem.
—नैषधान्वेषण (˚ध-अन्˚), अम्, n. the
seeking or searching for Naiṣadha, i. e. Nala.

नैषधीय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Nala Nai-
ṣadha; (अम्), n. (with or without चरित) N. of
an artificial epic poem on Nala's adventures by
Śrī-harṣa.

नैषध्य, अस्, ई, अम्, peculiar or belonging
to the Niṣadhas; (अस्), m. a prince of the Ni-
ṣadhas.

नैषिध, अस्, m. an epithet of Naḍa, (an earlier
form of नैषध above.)

नैषाद नैषाद, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to
the Niṣādas; (अस्), m. a Niṣāda; (आस्), m. pl. the
Niṣāda people.
नैषादि, इस्, m. a prince of the Niṣādas.

नैष्कर्म्य नैष्कर्म्य, अम्, n. (fr. निष्-कर्-
मन्), idleness, inactivity; abstinence or exemption
from acts or their consequences; the salvation obtained
by abstraction in opposition to that obtained by
works.

नैष्कशतिक नैष्कशतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
निष्क-शत), worth a hundred Niṣkas, bought
with them, &c.

नैष्कसहस्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निष्क-स-
हस्र), worth a thousand Niṣkas, bought with
them, &c.

नैष्किक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निष्क), bought with a
Niṣka, made of a Niṣka, &c.; (अस्), m. a Mint-
master, superintendent of a Mint.

नैष्किञ्चन्य नैष्किञ्चन्य, अम्, n. (fr. निष्-
किञ्चन), absence of property, poverty, destitution.

नैष्कृतिक नैष्कृतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, acting
wickedly, wicked, malignant, (probably incorrect for
नैकृतिक); free from occupation, disengaged.

नैष्क्रमण नैष्क्रमण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निष्-
क्रमण), any oblation offered or rite performed
when a new-born child is taken out of the house for
the first time.

नैष्ठिक नैष्ठिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-ष्ठा),
forming the end or conclusion, final, last; conclusive,
definitive, decided, accomplished, fixed, firm, con-
stant; highest, perfect, complete; completely versed
in or familiar with conversant; vowing perpetual
abstinence and chastity; belonging to the character
or office of a perpetual student; (अस्), m. a perpetual
religious student or Brāhman who continues with his
spiritual preceptor even after the prescribed term of
study is expired and observes the vow of chastity.

नैष्ठ्य, अम्, n. constancy, steady adherence to
rule, firm belief.

नैष्ठुर्य नैष्ठुर्य, अम्, n. (fr. नि-ष्ठुर),
severity, cruelty, coarseness, harshness.

नैष्णिह्य नैष्णिह्य, अम्, n. (apparently fr.
a form नि-ष्णिह् = निः-स्निह्), getting rid of, freeing
one's self from anything.

नैष्फल्य नैष्फल्य, अम्, n. (fr. निष्-
[]
फल), unfruitfulness, fruitlessness, absence of fruit
or effect, barrenness, unprofitableness.

नैसर्प नैसर्प, अस्, m. (fr. an unused form
नि-सर्प), N. of one of the nine treasures (with Jainas).

नैस्त्रिंशिक नैस्त्रिंशिक, अस्, m. (fr. निस्-
त्रिंश), a swordsman, a soldier armed with a sword.
